Priya Shah: heads up, last night a config merge left some routes honoring old quotas for ~20s. repro below. anyone else see this?
Marcus Li: saw small window in staging. sounds like applier wins but route-cache TTL shows stale values.
Priya Shah: repro: `POST /v1/configs/merge` body '{"target_scope":"route","changes":[{"id":"r-77","quota_multiplier":0.7}]}' then check applier logs -> apply ok but billing traces old multiplier briefly.
Ben Ortiz: we need explicit merge semantics + CAS etag. current fieldwise merge is brittle with arrays/maps.
Dana Morales: console asks: show last-applied etag, diff preview, estimated affected count, and dry-run toggle (sampled for big customers).
Marcus Li: full dry-run on 100k routes is too expensive. propose sampled dry-run cohorts + shadow-apply for full validation.
Priya Shah: we emit config.apply_success and config.drift_count. Console can surface drift spikes per config and trigger alerts.
Ben Ortiz: API idea: PATCH /v1/configs/{id}?merge_mode=merge&dry_run=true -> preview with changed_routes + sample list; 409 on etag conflict with conflict paths.
Marcus Li: plan: RFC + migration: new strict-mode by default for new clients; legacy kept ~3 releases with deprecation header.
ops-bot: Shadow-apply scheduled: shadow-A on 2026-06-15T03:00:00Z, runner=config-applier-v2 (shadow=true).
Priya Shah: assigning Ben+Priya to draft RFC and console mock. sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll post RFC link here when ready. end.
